existing_features.title: Update the post-"Yes" celebratory reveal section (the state rendered when `answered === true` in `frontend/src/App.tsx`) to look noticeably more cute/soft while keeping the existing meme image, heading, and romantic message content.

Add cute decorative visuals to the reveal page using new static image assets in `frontend/public/assets/generated` (e.g., kawaii heart/sparkle stickers and/or a subtle repeating background pattern), and render them in the reveal layout without fetching them from the backend.

Enhance the reveal page motion to feel softer/cuter (e.g., gentle float/bob or sparkle-like subtle animation on decorative elements) while preserving the existing fade/scale-in feel and avoiding distracting motion.
